title: George Friedman, "Europe: Destined for Conflict?"
summary: George Friedman of Stratfor speaks at the Chicago Council on Global Affairs about flashpoints in Europe that he expects to erupt again, including borderlands and cultural fault lines.
why: Some recommend it for his geopolitical framing, including a prediction of the Russia-Ukraine conflict, while others found his candor about US policy shocking.

quote.text: I recommend to watch George Friedman's talk
